import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform_v1
from google.api_core.client_options import ClientOptions
from google.protobuf import struct_pb2

def invoke_platform_model(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    project = config.get("project") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
    location = config.get("location") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION", "us-central1")
    endpoint_id = config.get("endpoint_id") or os.environ["VERTEX_AI_ENDPOINT_ID"]
    api_endpoint = f"{location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com"
    client = aiplatform_v1.PredictionServiceClient(
        client_options=ClientOptions(api_endpoint=api_endpoint)
    )

    endpoint = client.endpoint_path(project=project, location=location, endpoint=endpoint_id)

    instance = struct_pb2.Value()
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        struct_value = struct_pb2.Struct()
        struct_value.update(payload)
        instance.struct_value.CopyFrom(struct_value)
    elif isinstance(payload, list):
        list_value = struct_pb2.ListValue()
        for item in payload:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                s = struct_pb2.Struct()
                s.update(item)
                v = struct_pb2.Value()
                v.struct_value.CopyFrom(s)
                list_value.values.append(v)
            elif isinstance(item, str):
                v = struct_pb2.Value()
                v.string_value = item
                list_value.values.append(v)
            elif isinstance(item, bool):
                v = struct_pb2.Value()
                v.bool_value = item
                list_value.values.append(v)
            elif isinstance(item, (int, float)):
                v = struct_pb2.Value()
                v.number_value = float(item)
                list_value.values.append(v)
            else:
                v = struct_pb2.Value()
                v.string_value = str(item)
                list_value.values.append(v)
        instance.list_value.CopyFrom(list_value)
    elif isinstance(payload, str):
        instance.string_value = payload
    elif isinstance(payload, bool):
        instance.bool_value = payload
    elif isinstance(payload, (int, float)):
        instance.number_value = float(payload)
    else:
        instance.string_value = str(payload)

    parameters = None
    if isinstance(config.get("parameters"), dict):
        parameters = struct_pb2.Value()
        p_struct = struct_pb2.Struct()
        p_struct.update(config["parameters"])
        parameters.struct_value.CopyFrom(p_struct)

    response = client.predict(
        endpoint=endpoint,
        instances=[instance],
        parameters=parameters,
    )
    result = [dict(pred) if hasattr(pred, "items") else pred for pred in response.predictions]
    return result
